items.title: Morphicons: Morphing Library for Stroke-Based Icons
items.blurb: Morph any SVG icon into any other with spring physics. Animate Lucide, Tabler and Heroicons in React, Vue, Svelte, React Native or vanilla JS. Zero dependencies, ~6 KB gzip.
